players.name: L.J. Cason
players.impact: Backup guard. Adds pressure on Elliot Cadeau.

130.notes: Cason was backup depth, moderate impact on rotation.

players.name: Joshua Jefferson
players.status: Questionable - sprained left ankle (March 20 vs Tennessee State, X-rays negative)
players.impact: Second-leading scorer (16.9 ppg, 7.6 rpg, 4.9 apg, 31.8 mpg). Key forward for rebounding and playmaking. X-rays negative is encouraging but ankle status must be monitored.

66.notes: Jefferson suffered ankle sprain early in 108-74 win. X-rays negative. Monitor availability for next round.

news_flags.headline: St. John's loses Donnie Freeman to torn Achilles
news_flags.description: Donnie Freeman, who transferred from Syracuse to St. John's, will miss the 2026-27 season after tearing his Achilles.

players.name: Nate Ament
players.status: Questionable - leg injury (suffered Feb 28 vs Alabama), playing through pain in obvious discomfort
players.impact: 17.5 PPG / 6.6 RPG / 2.5 APG | 30.2 MPG | 40.5% FG | freshman phenom, NBA draft prospect.

2633.notes: Ament soldiered through first weekend in visible discomfort. Not confirmed out but effectiveness is a major question mark heading into Sweet 16 vs Iowa State.

252.notes: BYU ceiling significantly lower without Saunders.

players.name: Silas Demary Jr.
players.status: Questionable - Grade 2 high ankle sprain (March 14 Big East final vs St. John's), played limited minutes in Round 2
players.impact: 10.9 PPG / 6.2 APG / 4.5 RPG | 29.1 MPG | 1.6 SPG | starting PG, primary ball handler and defender.

players.name: Jaylin Stewart
players.status: Questionable - knee inflammation, missed Big East tourney and Rounds 1 and 2

41.notes: Demary gutted through Grade 2 sprain in Round 2. Dan Hurley called it day-to-day. Not expected at 100% for Sweet 16 vs Michigan State. Stewart also questionable with knee inflammation.

news_flags.headline: UConn's Solo Ball to have wrist surgery, miss all of 2026-27
news_flags.description: UConn guard Solo Ball will undergo wrist surgery and miss the entire 2026-27 season.

players.name: Matt Hodge
players.impact: Starting forward. Season-ending ACL tear confirmed March 3.

222.notes: Hodge was a starting contributor. Villanova (24-8) must go deeper into bench.

players.name: Caleb Wilson
players.status: Out for season - broken right thumb (surgery March 5)
players.impact: Team's leading scorer (19.8 ppg) and rebounder (9.4 rpg). Top-5 NBA draft pick. Out since Feb 10 with left hand fracture, then broke right thumb dunking in practice March 5. UNC went 5-1 without him but faces tougher competition in tournament.

153.notes: UNC's go-to lineup without Wilson: Trimble/Dixon/Bogavac backcourt, Stevenson at 4, Veesaar at center. +22 net rating with that quintet in last 4 games but vs weaker ACC opponents.

players.name: C.J. Cox
players.status: Questionable - hyperextended right knee (March 22 vs Miami, did not return)
players.impact: 8.3 PPG / 2.6 RPG / 24.4 MPG | 38.4% 3P | starts all 36 games. Primary perimeter defender and sharpshooter.

2509.notes: Cox suffered hyperextended right knee on fast break in 2nd half. Matt Painter confirmed diagnosis. Listed game-time decision for Sweet 16 vs Texas (March 26). 4 days to recover.

players.name: JT Toppin
players.impact: All-America forward. Season-ending injury. Major loss.

2641.notes: Ceiling significantly lower without Toppin per ESPN.

players.name: Aden Holloway
players.status: Suspended - arrested March 16 on felony marijuana possession charge, removed from campus
players.impact: 16.8 PPG / 2.8 RPG / 3.8 APG | 28.4 MPG | 48.1% FG | 43.8% 3P | second-leading scorer.

333.notes: Holloway arrested March 16, $5,000 bond, suspended by program. Coach Nate Oats confirmed team preparing without him. Will NOT play vs Michigan in Sweet 16. London Jemison expected to start.

players.name: Braden Huff
players.status: Questionable - left knee injury (out since Jan 15, targeting NCAA tournament return)
players.impact: Leading scorer (17.8 ppg, 66.2% FG) — out since Jan 15. Gonzaga went 8-1 without him. Torvik rating already reflects 2 months of absence. Penalty reflects uncertainty about his readiness/effectiveness if he returns.

2250.notes: Graham Ike (19.9 ppg) has stepped up. Huff could return for Round 1 (Mar 19-20) but game-ready status unknown. If confirmed fully available, remove this override.

players.name: Carter Welling
players.impact: Season-ending torn ACL confirmed day before Selection Sunday.

228.notes: Welling injury came March 13 — very recent, Torvik may not have fully adjusted.

players.name: Tyler Bilodeau
players.status: Questionable - right leg injury (suffered March 14 vs Michigan St)
players.impact: Star player — right leg injury in Big Ten quarterfinal. Described as 'likely sideline for at least one game.' May miss Round 1 (Mar 19-20) but could return after.

26.notes: UCLA (23-11) won without him 88-84 vs Michigan St. Dent (23pts) and Perry (22pts) stepped up. Monitor for R1 availability update.
